I teach in the [Department of Electrical Engineering](https://teknik-elektro.fst.unja.ac.id/), Faculty of Science and Technology, Universitas Jambi. My courses cover artificial intelligence, data science and computational systems. A lot of the material comes from my time as a data scientist and from research I do with students here.

## Courses

- [Artificial Intelligence](artificial-intelligence/index.qmd)
- [Machine Learning](machine-learning/index.qmd)
- [Data Mining](data-mining/index.qmd)
- [Pattern Recognition](pattern-recognition/index.qmd)
- [Pengolahan Citra Digital](pengolahan-citra-digital/index.qmd) (Digital Image Processing)

## Teaching Philosophy

I try to keep courses practical. We start with the math so the ideas are clear, then move quickly to notebooks and small projects that use local data. I also bring in examples from retail and media, where a model has to be reliable and easy to explain, not just accurate in a notebook.

## Supervision

I supervise undergraduate student projects and theses (tugas akhir/skripsi) in topics such as:

- Machine learning and deep learning applications
- Computer vision and pattern recognition
- IoT systems and embedded intelligence
- Time-series forecasting and predictive systems
